verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned API surfaces: the Admin SDK Directory API reference and guides sit under v1 paths (directory/reference/rest/v1, directory/v1/guides), alongside a REST Reports API. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle commitments. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit version-lifecycle and migration guidance, and independent corroboration of version stability.
